t_advice_summary_textbox.text: there is no pattern, but the bias will switch periodcially through the game

vb_textbox.text: Each Gnome offers either a yellow or red basket; there will be one of each colour basket in each pair. The red basket seemed to deliver more mushrooms than the yellow ones consistently. The red baskets are offered by the gnomes with a red hat, blue hat, orange hat and pink hat. There were occasions when the yellow baskets gave a good number of mushrooms, but primarily it was the red baskets.
